premises.text: Smart lighting adoption fails because wired switches are hard/expensive to install and smart bulbs break normal switch use
premises.evidence_span: Why is it that a product meant to make our lives simple and better is such a pain to deal with right out of the box?

premises.text: Switchmate snaps magnetically onto standard light-switch screws and mechanically flips the switch for phone control without rewiring
premises.evidence_span: It uses two magnets on the back that snap right to the screws on your standard light switch. And it mechanically flips the switch up and down

premises.text: Hundreds of millions of U.S. homes including rentals and condos have switches that can be automated without in-wall install
premises.evidence_span: There's about 120 million homes in the United States alone, a third of them being rentals and condos

premises.text: Go-to-market moves from crowdfunding pre-orders to online retail then brick-and-mortar, with an experienced manufacturing partner
premises.evidence_span: Next month in February, we're planning to launch a pre-order campaign. We're also working with a manufacturing partner that has experience building multiple hardware products

domains.name: smart lighting friction and addressable switches

value.text: Simple smart-home lighting control anyone can install without electrician pain
value.evidence_span: we've developed a product that makes smart lighting extremely simple without dealing with any of these issues

causal_links.evidence_span: you can install smart lighting like that, and you're done
